title: Recheck verdict
description: The exact one-object response of a recheck verifier (Phase 1 recheck pass or recheck mode) checking a previously reported finding against the current code. Read by recheck prompts, the workflow graph, and validate_findings.py (enum agreement). Field semantics: verification.md.

result.description: Exactly one result; do not re-litigate the original verdict where the code has not changed.

status.description: Update, sent only for still_open and moved.

severity.description: Update, sent only for still_open and moved.

fingerprint.description: New fingerprint; only for moved (the orchestrator appends the old one to previous_fingerprints).

line_range.description: Updated line range; only for still_open and moved.

evidence.description: fixed and fixed_pending must cite the blocking code; cant_tell names the missing fact in reason.
